item.title: Maddie Bloomberg
item.description:
Hon. B.A. in Psychology, Western University
M.Sc. in Cognitive, Developmental, and Brain Sciences, Western University
Ph.D. Student, University of Toronto

Maddie is an incoming graduate student for Fall 2025. She completed her master’s at Western University studying individual differences in concept learning. Her research interests center on how people learn and use conceptual knowledge, the mechanisms that support memory updating and creation, and how prior knowledge is applied to new situations. Outside of research, she enjoys being active, searching for the best iced coffee in the city, and experimenting with new recipes.

item.title: Linda He
item.description:
University of Toronto Psychology Research Specialist, Bioethics and Sociology Minor

Linda was a thesis student in the MackLab and continues working on her project as a research assistant. She is currently a lab manager with the Duncan and Finn labs. She is passionate about cognitive neuroscience research, and is currently working on projects investigating semantic memory updating during category exception learning and the psychophysiological signatures of insight. She has additional interests in understanding how neurological and psychiatric disorders impact cognitive functioning. Outside of the lab, she enjoys bouldering, practicing ballet, playing guitar, and listening to live music.

item.title: Mohan Yuan
item.description:
University of Toronto Psychology Research Specialist, Computer Science Minor

Mohan is an honours thesis student in the Mack Lab. She is particularly interested in the underlying mechanisms of human memory and learning. She is currently working on a project investigating how attentional processes unfold during learning by tracking eye movements. In her free time, she enjoys drawing, discovering new recipes, and exploring matcha desserts around Toronto.
